pure-announcement.rationale: It is REST API reference documentation for existing Copilot metrics endpoints, not a launch, release note or funding announcement.

duplicate.rationale: The nearest concepts are MCP-governance and retrieval topics; nothing in the corpus covers Copilot usage-metrics reporting endpoints.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Endpoint paths, scopes and response shapes are all verifiable against GitHub's live REST API and published docs.

durability.rationale: It is an endpoint-by-endpoint reference pinned to API version 2026-03-10, including a public-preview endpoint explicitly 'subject to change' and date-bound availability windows (reports from 2025-10-10, 1-year retention, per_page max 25).

actionability.rationale: The actions are curl calls and token scopes against one vendor's product endpoints; nothing here transfers beyond retrieving GitHub Copilot report files.

atomicity.rationale: Despite listing ~10 endpoints, it is one statable idea: GitHub exposes daily and 28-day Copilot usage reports as downloadable NDJSON via enterprise- and org-level REST endpoints.
